They blurred the line so everything is grey, and the Black congregant is the prey.
precepts.point: I have seen in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, walk in lies, and strengthen the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness. When Jamal Bryant was checked over his wife's dress he doubled down, so when we tell his congregants on the street to repent, they double down too. They are all to God as Sodom, and he will feed them wormwood and gall.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says “both prophet and priest are profane”. Ezekiel shows what that looks like: “There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls”. These pastors devour your souls. “they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof”, through adultery.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean”. They blurred the lines. There is no right or wrong now, just a grey area in the middle: do a little evil, a little good, everything is grey. “and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.”

“Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.” The black Christian congregants are the prey. It is money, money, money; covetousness is what they are. Juanita Bynum can charge over a thousand dollars for a prayer class and be that bold because the black community does not know the Bible.

That is the profaneness Jeremiah says has “gone forth into all the land” from the prophets. Teaching prosperity and that the laws of God are done away produces adulterers, gangbangers, murderers and debauchery, and the land is full of adulterers because of it.

precepts.text: The Most High condemns those who greedily gain of their neighbors by extortion and shed blood, smiting his hand against dishonest gain.
precepts.point: Ahab shares the guilt. He sat by and let Jezebel commit the crime because he coveted the field, then turned his face from the evil and went to claim the reward.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

precepts.why:
“In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord God. Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.”

When Naboth was dead, Jezebel said, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money”, and Ahab rose up to go down and take it. That is extortion: seizing what another has by violence and force, and greedily gaining of a neighbour with blood.

Ahab shares the guilt. He sat by and let Jezebel commit the crime because he coveted the field, then turned his face from the evil and went to claim the reward. The Most High smites his hand at that dishonest gain.

precepts.text: Who will rise up against the evildoers and stand up against the workers of iniquity, which is the hedge and the gap of one who would turn the Lord's wrath from the people.
precepts.point: He sought for a man to make up the hedge and stand in the gap before Him so He would not destroy the land, but He found none, so He poured out His indignation and consumed them with the fire of His wrath.
precepts.why:
“I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.” The psalm asks the same question: “Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?”

That is the hedge and the gap. The one who would turn the Lord's wrath from the people is the one who rises up against the evildoers and stands up against the workers of iniquity. And look who the workers of iniquity were: her prophets in a conspiracy “like a roaring lion ravening the prey”, devouring souls and making many widows; her priests who violated His law and “put no difference between the holy and profane”, hiding their eyes from His sabbaths; her princes “like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain”; prophets daubing them with untempered morter, saying “Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken”; and the people of the land using oppression, robbery and vexing the poor and needy and the stranger. The leaders of Israel were very corrupt, and the same oppression, robbery and extortion ran through the leadership.

It is just like today, where our people put no difference between anything, and it is called Christianity. Nobody rose up against the evildoers, He found none, so He poured out His indignation and consumed them with the fire of His wrath, recompensing their own way upon their heads.

points: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken. What is untempered morter? When you temper a piece of metal you heat it up, you put it in water, you bang it, you heat it up, and it strengthens it. So untempered morter is morter that is not strengthened. It cannot hold up anything. So her prophets have daubed them with vanities, with false things, things that cannot hold any weight. It is not going to survive the test of time.

points: The word of the Most High comes to Ezekiel to judge the bloody city, Jerusalem, and show her all her abominations.
She has shed blood in her midst and made idols against herself to defile herself, causing her days to draw near.
Because of her idolatry and wickedness, once judgment comes He makes her a reproach unto the heathen and a mocking to all countries, both near and far.
The princes of Israel used their power to shed blood, set light by father and mother, dealt by oppression with the stranger, and vexed the fatherless and the widow.
They despised His holy things, profaned His sabbaths, carried tales to shed blood, ate upon the mountains, and committed lewdness in her midst.
They broke all manner of the immoral laws of Leviticus 18, committing abomination with a neighbor's wife, defiling a daughter-in-law, and humbling a sister, doing the doings of the other nations.
They took gifts to shed blood, being put on the take and paid off to shed a man's blood, took usury and increase, and greedily gained by extortion, and have forgotten Him; these are wicked leaders.
The Most High smites His hand at their dishonest gain and at the blood shed in their midst, asking whether their heart can endure or their hands be strong in the day He deals with them.

He will scatter them among the heathen, disperse them in the countries, and consume their filthiness out of them, and they shall know that He is the Lord when they take their inheritance in the sight of the heathen.
The house of Israel is become dross to Him, all brass, tin, iron, and lead, the dross of silver in the midst of the furnace.
He will gather them into the midst of Jerusalem as men gather metal into the furnace, and blow the fire of His wrath upon them.
They shall be melted in the midst of the furnace as silver is melted, and shall know that He is the Lord who poured out His fury upon them.

The land is not cleansed nor rained upon, and there is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst, like a roaring lion ravening the prey, devouring souls and making many widows; the leaders of Israel are very corrupt.

Her priests violated His law and profaned His holy things, putting no difference between the holy and the profane or the clean and the unclean and hiding their eyes from His sabbaths, just like today where our people put no difference between anything, and it is called Christianity.

Her princes are like wolves ravening the prey to shed blood and destroy souls for dishonest gain, and her prophets daub them with untempered mortar, seeing vanity and divining lies, saying thus saith the Lord God when He has not spoken.
The people used oppression, exercised robbery, and vexed the poor and needy and the stranger wrongfully, showing the same oppression, robbery, and extortion by the leadership.

He sought for a man to make up the hedge and stand in the gap before Him so He would not destroy the land, but He found none, so He poured out His indignation and consumed them with the fire of His wrath.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things”. They put no difference between holy and profane. They come up with all type of foolishness, follow it, and tell the people to follow it too. “neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths”. Christmas, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Easter, Thanksgiving, First Lady Day, Building Day—all type of foolishness. They're following Satan to the fullest in them buildings. They don't know Christ, and they're teaching our people not to know Christ, to stay away from him. Satan has to gather his two-thirds while we're out here gathering the one-third.
